title: Missing moeb tool: web-search for GitHub Actions version lookup
description: Step 3 of moeb.github-actions-release-actions-inline-version-resolution required identifying the latest node24-native stable release tags for actions/checkout, actions/cache, and softprops/action-gh-release using inline training knowledge. Training knowledge (cutoff August 2025) was insufficient to confirm specific node24-native tags for releases likely published after that date. All three returned null and the workflow upgrade was not performed, leaving FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: true in place. A web-search or GitHub API query tool would allow the agent to resolve current release tags at implementation time without relying on potentially stale training knowledge.
proposed_resolution: Add a web_search or github_releases moeb tool that queries the GitHub releases API for a given action repository and returns the latest tag whose action.yml declares a specified runs.using version. This would make the inline version resolution step reliable across any knowledge cutoff date.
